findings.title: CloudFront distribution allows HTTP
findings.description: A cache behavior with viewer_protocol_policy = "allow-all" serves content over unencrypted HTTP. Use "https-only" or "redirect-to-https".

findings.title: CloudFront distribution without a response headers policy
findings.description: A CloudFront distribution with no response_headers_policy_id serves responses without hardened security headers (HSTS, frame-options, content-type options). Attach a response headers policy such as the managed SecurityHeadersPolicy.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.
